distribution.completed: CI built and loaded the PR156 CLI image, but only retained a Docker image config ID and small proof, not a registry artifact.
distribution.required: Build the integration image from reviewed exact source and locked inputs, independently verify its runtime guards, then obtain explicit authorization to upload it to the private Cloudflare registry. Resolve and retain the OCI registry manifest digest, compare image provenance, and generate the activation diff against that exact digest. The old Docker config ID is not an OCI distribution manifest digest.
distribution.notAuthorized: No registry upload, hosted provisioning, deployment or paid pilot start has been authorized.

costEnvelope.qualification: Gross container-only estimates before included usage, assuming maximum CPU usage and verified termination. Excludes Workers, Durable Objects, R2 operations/storage, registry storage, logs, network and applicable plan charges. A control-plane outage or unverified stop invalidates the duration assumption; this is not a guaranteed invoice cap.
